texts.uz: Sukut boʻyicha hech narsa siz ruxsat bermaguningizcha ommaga chiqmaydi. Tayyor video YouTube kanalingizga shaxsiy video sifatida yuboriladi, avval esa nashr tekshiruvi ishlaydi. Videoni koʻrib chiqasiz va «Tasdiqlash va nashr qilish» tugmasini bosasiz. Avtomatik nashr har bir kanal uchun alohida sozlanadi va siz yoqmaguningizcha oʻchiq turadi.
texts.ru: По умолчанию ничего не становится публичным, пока вы не разрешите. Готовое видео отправляется на ваш YouTube-канал как приватное, а перед этим проходит проверку перед публикацией. Вы смотрите ролик и нажимаете «Одобрить и опубликовать». Автопубликация включается отдельно для каждого канала и выключена, пока вы её не включите.
texts.en: By default, nothing goes public until you say so. A finished video is sent to your YouTube channel as private, and a publish check runs first. You watch it, then press Approve and publish. Auto-publish is a switch for each channel and stays off until you turn it on.

evidence.claim: Uploads are private by default: YOUTUBE_PRIVACY defaults to private.
A channel's auto_publish column defaults to false, so a video stays private until a human approves it.
When the channel's auto-publish switch is off, the upload privacy is clamped to private whatever was requested.
A publish gate runs in front of an upload and can block it; it can never cause one.
The review panel shows the preview, the script and the gate verdict, and its Approve and publish button only files a request; a browser never publishes.
The public Studio page describes the same flow: private upload, publish check, the owner's button, auto-publish off until turned on.
